# CSLPPS: Concerted Silence-Based Location Privacy Preserving Scheme for Internet of Vehicles
Leila Benarous, Salim Bitam, Abdelhamid Mellouk · IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology 2021 · https://doi.org/10.1109/tvt.2021.3088762 · relevance: high · basis: abstract

**Problem:** The Internet of Vehicles (IoV) connects vehicles together and also to other internet of things components such as sensors and smart devices.
**Approach:** The huge amount of data generated by these components is stored in the cloud, so does the services offered which are not limited to safety applications but also to infotainment where most of these services use the position and identity of the vehicle. Due to these requirements, the privacy of road users is at threat.
